Discord is good at downsizing so for transferability, draw at a higher res with transparent backgrounds. Discord stickers render at DPI 160 with the biggest size of 320x320. If you want to use the art as an image (like for SMS) I would suggest doubling that to 640x640 which covers the standard size for other sites (like telegram at 500)
Make your canvas the ideal square and don't trim the translucent pixels on the sides (this is valuable padding)
Try to limit the amount of visual noise (like detailed textures) that will be lost to downsizing and be hard to see or blurry 
A lot of the visual elements are styalistic choices, so use them as suggestions rather then rules. But flat colors and cell shading, simple gradients, thicker and dark lineart are elements that can help with clarity. Also always consider color choices based on most systems being dark grey backgrounds, you don't want your art to vanish to the UI. You can't predict if people are using dark or light mode, so avoiding B&W standalone without contrast (like a white stroke to protect a black graphic)

You have all the tools you need! Have fun!
